text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's incredible, so many of them!
It's truly a divine feat!
choice_data_list: I wonder if having this much will help with the manga?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so!
Hehe... I'm actually a little touched.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "You worked so hard to win this for the sake of my manga, after all!"
choice_data_list: Because I'm a fan of your manga!
Because I'm a fan of your manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thank you very much!
All right, I definitely have to make this an amazing piece!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Once the rough draft is finished,
I want you to be the very first to read it—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Because I want you to be the very first person to tell me it's 'interesting!', Trainer!
